subject: Mid-quarter playbook: prioritized re-scopes & dependency requests
messages:
From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter playbook: prioritized re-scopes & dependency requests

Team —

Quick mid-quarter status and a short set of asks before QBR prep week. I attached a compact playbook (midq_playbook_v2.pdf) and a dependency tracker (dependency_tracker.csv). Highlights and asks below — please skim and call out any redlines before EOD Friday.

1) Serving runtime perf (OKR: 99th pct latency <= 220ms) — current status: 62% of milestone work complete.
   - Recent: FP16 kernel rollout on p4d staging improved median but 99th still +18% over target.
   - Blocker: kernel rollout depends on infra-side KV-cache tuning and perf regression sign-off from infra.
   - Ask: Infrastructure alignment and 1 FTE s/w lead from Runtime infra to own kv-cache tuning spike (owner: vanessa). Target: turnaround by 2026-10-07.

2) Dedicated onboarding (OKR: 3 enterprise pilots onboarded) — current status: pilot cadence at 40% complete.
   - Recent: ACME pilot (Sarah) is ready for Dedicated network tests pending SOC attestation answers.
   - Blocker: procurement & security questionnaire turnaround and SOW execution.
   - Ask: sales/procurement to expedite security appendix and SOW signature; legal has a draft but we need Procurement contact from ACME to finish DocuSign flow. (cc: Sarah).

3) Optimize toolkit (OKR: 20% token cost reduction for common prompts) — current status: prototyping at 75%.
   - Recent: initial batching/caching config shows 12% token cost reduction on internal traces.
   - Blocker: need customer-representative prompts to validate quality delta vs quantized model.
   - Ask: Product to assemble 3 canonical prompt-sets and send to Applied ML by 2026-10-04.

Decisions I propose in the pack: narrow Dedicated onboarding scope for Q4 (delay 2 lower-priority pilots) to free 2 FTEs for runtime KV work and give the Optimize toolkit a short burst to complete validations. See section 3 of the attached deck for the re-scope rationale and impact estimate.

Action items (short):
- Vanessa: lead KV spike and sync with infra (due 2026-10-07).
- Laura: confirm availability of 2 engineers we can shift for 4 weeks (reply with names).
- Markus: OK to sign off on pilot re-scope direction?
- Sales/Procurement: confirm ACME procurement contact + target sign date (cc Sarah).

Attachments: midq_playbook_v2.pdf (slides), dependency_tracker.csv (spreadsheet)

Thanks — brief read, then let's align on Friday 10/1 10am for 20 minutes if needed.

—
Chloe Martin
Senior PM, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter playbook: prioritized re-scopes & dependency requests

Chloe — thanks for the clear summary and the deck. A few clarifications so we can action quickly: 

1) When you say "1 FTE s/w lead" for the KV spike, do you mean a hands-on engineer or a technical PM? If hands-on, I can swing two engineers for a 3-week sprint, but I need names by EOD Friday to plan sprint coverage.

2) For ACME procurement: my contact is procurement@acme.com but if Sarah can provide the direct buyer name that accelerates things. Can Legal and Sales combine to send the SOC answers as a single package to reduce back-and-forth?

3) On the Optimize toolkit: can Product paste the three prompt-sets into a shared doc (link in deck) and tag Applied ML so we have an audit trail for quality checks?

I can confirm potential reassignments: I have two engineers (Priya N. and Marcus L.) who are available Oct 4–25 for focused work if Markus agrees.

—
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter playbook: prioritized re-scopes & dependency requests

Chloe — good, pragmatic plan. Approve the proposed re-scope to pull two engineers for the KV tuning spike, conditional on: 

- A documented rollback/fallback for the FP16 kernel path if 99th pct regressions persist. Please add a short "fallback decision" checklist to the dependency tracker.
- We need SLO simulation numbers to justify trade-offs. Can you have SRE produce the impact simulations (latency trade vs cost) and attach them as an xlsx? I expect numbers by COB 2026-10-06.

Also: Laura, thanks — Priya N. and Marcus L. are fine. Have them coordinate with Vanessa on day 1 knowledge transfer.

On the Dedicated pilot with ACME: Sarah, if you can confirm the procurement buyer and expected sign date we can book the network test window. If procurement wants a faster review, Sasha in Legal can do an expedited pass.

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, 28 Sep 2026 at 09:12, chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Team —
> > 
> > Quick mid-quarter status and a short set of asks before QBR prep week...

Attachment: slo_simulations.xlsx

—
Markus Klein
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter playbook: prioritized re-scopes & dependency requests

Thanks, Chloe — appreciate the concise asks and timeline. Quick notes from ACME side: 

- Procurement contact: Miguel Ortega (miguel.ortega@acme.com). He expects a standard SOW + SOC2 answers package; target sign date: 2026-10-12 if we can deliver the DocuSign package this week.
- I have attached our SOW outline for reference (acme_sow.pdf). I can route the security questionnaire to Miguel and ask procurement to reply directly to Laura to speed things up.
- DocuSign link will be active after legal finalizes the appendix; here is the placeholder link: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ZX9-ACME-2026-09-29

On the Dedicated tests: we can hold a network test window on 2026-10-18–20; please confirm slots after the SOW is in place.

Best —
Sarah Lopez
Director, Cloud Integrations
Acme Corporation

Attachment: acme_sow.pdf
